items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: Fritz and Jimmie Noone was two of my favorite players in those days.

ctx.x: When you talk about technique, do you mean actually knowing what he was doing on the horn, or facility?
By the way he played and the tone. I could tell in those days. Fritz and Jimmie Noone was two of my favorite players in those days.
